string.text: Field-strip weapons in inventory or loot. Keybinds and options below.
Hover a weapon and use these binds to remove all attachments and parts. Hold mode strips each newly hovered weapon. Works in the stack popup.
Strip all first when you disassemble a weapon with unstripped attachments or parts, press again to disassemble normally.
Move stripped attachments and parts back to the weapon's inventory.
Moving equipped items into a companion inventory (PDA, NVG, etc.) can make them vanish. Loose bag items still move normally.
Prevent moving equipped items into a companion inventory (some items can vanish).
